card.name: Pre- at start of premedication words
card.fires_on: The prefix "pre" (or "PRE") starting words like premedicate, pre-treated and prehydration, usually after "should be" or "were". It also fires weakly on "mg" before a slash such as mg/day.

modes.label: Pre- before treatment verbs
modes.description: The prefix "pre" opens a word meaning treatment given before a drug or infusion, such as premedicate, pre-treated or prehydration.
modes.example: All patients should be<< pre>>medicated with oral corticosteroids

modes.label: mg before a slash
modes.description: The unit "mg" right after a number and before "/day" or "/dose".

card.writes: It pushes against the "load" and "loading" words, which is not tied to the pre- pattern, so there is no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It marks the start of words like premedicate, meaning something given before the main drug.
